approved_scope: Native combat only: gold tier3 katana combo, Sword Shield, bazooka and charged lock-on, land locomotion/jump/hurt/death. Swimming/Mermaid, pool and flute excluded.
method: Original ROM MIPS sound sequencer executed with Unicorn. Original N64 ADPCM samples/predictor books, pitch, duration, volume ramps and pan preserved. Dry offline stereo PCM uses linear resampling and equal-power pan. Original RSP interpolation/filter and room reverb are not emulated. Not a bit-exact emulator capture. No synthesized replacement sounds.

source_action_proof.method:
Execute USA ROM MIPS dispatch, native Yae sound curves and guarded releases.
Fixtures only replace RNG choice, sound API, effect allocation/action switching,
animation length and unrelated environment queries. Native character/random
lookup, source event decoding, attack initialization, release guards and victim
contact selection run original instructions.

katana_entry_voices.native_voice_time: entry / 0 seconds; second strike group0 is silent

charged_projectile_initializer.note: Original charged loop runs all three calls; allocation and downstream model setup are fixtures.

bazooka_collision_receipt.charged_note: Charged initializer801F0F84 invokes same native801EE980 for each of its three missiles.

hurt_entry.note: Dispatch group2 selects all three Yae hurt voices.

sword_shield_spin.note: The two rendered sword effects share one source sound queue; identical calls in one game frame coalesce.

raw_land_footfall_gates.runtime_alignment: Use the same source frame rate and frame_count-1 loop duration as displayed native poses. The terminal key is the next loop frame0 and is counted once. No fixed-Hz footstep timer.

land_footfalls.note: Native ordinary land footfall event217 is preserved. Runtime aligns the native footfall gate timeline with the displayed land gait; source water/underwater terrain variants are excluded from the approved combat-only kit.

native_queue_coalescence.note: Repeated identical event IDs in the same game-frame queue play once. Different ticks remain separate source event cues.

silent_event: Event201 is all-zero PCM; known source-silent slots return null.

runtime_cues.land_footfalls: event217; native ground movement0C–0F dispatch group1. Native gate frames0/midpoint/endpoint follow the same animation clock, source rate and loop duration as the displayed pose; endpoint/frame0 is counted once.
runtime_cues.katana_3_weapon: tick5 events217+216; tick6 event216; entry voice group6 (3A6/3A2/3A2)
runtime_cues.bazooka_weapon: event102 at source release threshold, with separate voice group6. Charged three-missile release queues the firing event once.
runtime_cues.sword_shield: Entry silent. Held source effect state1 emits214 every3 ticks at30Hz. Duplicate calls from the two swords coalesce in native frame queue. Blocked attackclass6 emits23B.
runtime_cues.charge: Mode3 emits24C at heldtick15. Shared effect11 sustains24D/E; full-charge tick60 only spawns target effect1C and has no additional sound.

adaptation_silence: Dash, unverified environmental hits and an unproven standalone bazooka explosion have no fabricated audio. Runtime contact uses verified221/24F events; actual shield blocking uses23B.

proof.source_initializer: 0x801EC5B4 allocates3 actors;0x801EE4AC zeroes their counters;actor+61 indices0/1/2
proof.method: Original effect handler executed up to render work; only model scale helper and sound API hooked. All cadence/state/actor branches original.
proof.conclusion: While charge state1or2, every actor calls24D at effect ticks30/90/etc and24E at60/120/etc. Release states0or3 suppress cues. Effect spawned at held tick15: first periodiccue is ~heldtick45(1.5s), then every1s. Three same-ID calls are simultaneous.
